skill_name: Generate an example of a scientific experiment that could be used to test the hypothesis stated in the following passage.
workflow: An experiment to test this hypothesis could involve observing species of fish in two different temperature environments, with one kept at a fairly constant temperature, and the other slowly heated or cooled over the course of a few weeks or months. Researchers could then compare the number and types of fish at each site, and any differences in the abundance or diversity of fish species could indicate an impact of temperature on the aquatic environment.
